values: Event | 1948 : WHO Constitution comes into force
Event | 1974 : WHO founds the Expanded Programme on Immunization to bring life-saving vaccines to all the world's children
Event | 1978 : WHO launches the global diarrhoeal diseases programme with Oral rehydration salts (ORS) at its heart

Event | 1978 : The International Conference on Primary Health Care, in Alma-Ata, Kazakhstan, sets the aspirational goal, 'Health for All' laying the groundwork for WHO's call for universal health coverage
Event | 1980 : Following an ambitious 12-year global vaccination campaign led by WHO, smallpox is eradicated
Event | 1988 : The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI), is launched
Event | 1999 : The first global strategy for the prevention and control of noncommunicable diseases (NCDs)
Event | 2000 : The WHO Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN) is established to detect and combat the international spread of outbreaks
Event | 2003 : The World Health Assembly unanimously adopts WHO's first global public health treaty, the WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control

Event | 2003 : WHO launches the '3 by 5' initiative, which aims to bring treatment to 3 million people living with HIV by 2005 and lays the groundwork for reaching 13 million people infected with HIV with antiretroviral treatment by 2013
Event | 2004 : WHO co-established the UN Road Safety Collaboration to prevent road traffic injuries
Event | 2005 : The International Health Regulations are revised
Event | 2006 : WHO Child Growth Standards are launched to help every child grow in an equitable way
Event | 2012 : The World Health Assembly adopts WHO's implementation plan on maternal, infant, and young child nutrition
Event | 2014 : The Every Newborn Action Plan is endorsed by the World Health Assembly
Event | 2015 : All United Nations Member States adopt the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development
Event | 2019 : UN Declaration on Universal Health Coverage
Event | 2020 : Access to COVID-19 Tools Accelerator
Event | 2021 : More than 74 million lives had been saved through tuberculosis prevention, diagnosis and treatment since 2000
Event | 2021 : HIV treatment coverage expanded rapidly with well over 17 million people living with HIV on antiretroviral therapy by the end of 2015
Event | 2022 : Agreement for cooperation on the health of humans, animals, plants and the environment
Event | 2023 : WHO's 75th anniversary
summary: The figure is a timeline illustrating key milestones in public health improvements led or supported by WHO from 1948 to 2023. It highlights foundational events such as the WHO Constitution coming into force, major disease eradication efforts like smallpox and polio, global health initiatives on immunization, nutrition, and outbreak response, as well as recent achievements including the COVID-19 response and WHO's 75th anniversary. The timeline emphasizes WHO's evolving role in global health governance and disease prevention over seventy-five years.
